image_note: No hosted image yet: no card image has been rendered or hosted, so image is null rather than a placeholder URL.

merkle.leaf: sha256 of the token metadata as canonical JSON (keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit, no whitespace, no trailing newline); each token file is written in exactly that form, so sha256(file bytes) is its leaf
merkle.node: sha256(min(a, b) || max(a, b)) over the raw 32-byte values (sorted pairs, so proofs carry no left/right flags)
merkle.odd: an unpaired node moves up a level unchanged
merkle.proof: h = leaf; for each sibling s in order: h = node(h, s); valid when h equals the root
